Package ui

Class CustomerView

java.lang.Object
ui.CustomerView
public class CustomerView extends Object
Customer-facing display for the register, shown in its own window. It mirrors the cashier's current order while items are rung up. At checkout the customer picks a tip and a payment method and pays here.

The window has four screens under a shared header:

  • Welcome: the idle screen between customers, up until the cashier adds the first item.
  • Your Order: the live item list and totals while the cashier adds items.
  • Checkout: tip, payment method and the Pay button, after the cashier clicks Finish Order.
  • Thank You: the order number and amount paid, shown for a few seconds after paying.

CashierView owns the order and drives the flow. This class only shows the order and reports the customer's payment back through the callback given to startCheckout(double, java.util.function.Consumer<model.PaymentResult>). It never saves anything itself.

    • placeOnSecondScreen

      private void placeOnSecondScreen()
      Fills the whole second monitor, if there is one, so the customer screen faces away from the cashier. With a single monitor the window keeps its default size and position. javafx.stage.Screen is written out in full because ui.Screen already uses the name.

    • refresh

      Redraws the order and totals. CashierView calls this whenever the order changes, including changes inside a line (quantity, sugar, ice, toppings) that the list itself can't notice.

    • startCheckout

      public void startCheckout(double subtotal, Consumer<PaymentResult> onPay)
      Switches to checkout: the customer chooses a tip and a payment method, then taps Pay. The tip and payment buttons are built fresh each time, so nothing from the last customer carries over. The tip choices and rules come from PaymentDialog, so both ways of paying always offer the same options.
      Parameters:
      subtotal - the order subtotal before tax, the same amount CashierView saves
      onPay - gets the customer's tip and payment method when they tap Pay

    • cancelCheckout
